name: Robert Biedroń, Nikolas Farantouris - § 24/1
title: REPORT on implementation and delivery of the Sustainable Development Goals in view of the 2025 High-Level Political Forum
part_text: Text as a whole without the words: ‘and rights’, and the second ‘R’ in the acronym ‘SRHR’ (2 occurrences) and ‘and upholding women’s and girls’ bodily autonomy’
part_context: Recalls that the full realisation of sexual and reproductive health <del>and rights</del> (SRHR) and upholding women’s and girls’ bodily autonomy is critical to achieving gender equality; highlights that SRHR are an integral part of the universal health coverage and are critical to achieving SDG 3, particularly target 3.7; calls on the Commission to ensure that SRHR are included in EU initiatives and programmes on universal health coverage;
